title: The Query Knows What to Forget: A Second Erase Direction for Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.13668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear attention keeps a state of fixed size. At long context, many stored items share this state, and interference between them degrades retrieval. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2), like every delta-rule model before it, derives its erase vector from the key of the current token. However, the interference in its reads is measured through the query, and the erase step cannot reach it. We introduce the Query-derived Erase Direction (QED). QED adds a second erase direction derived from the query and orthogonal to the key. In the fast-weight view, a key-directed delta edit cannot change the key-orthogonal part of a read. It uses the editable part to cancel old-state content measured along the query. It also improves retrieval at every length past the training window, and it about doubles the usable context length on S-NIAH-1.

translated_title: 查询知道该遗忘什么：线性注意力的第二个擦除方向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13668v1 公告类型：新 摘要：线性注意力保持一个固定大小的状态。在长上下文中，许多存储的项共享此状态，它们之间的干扰会降低检索性能。Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) 与之前所有delta规则模型一样，其擦除向量源自当前令牌的键。然而，其读取中的干扰是通过查询来衡量的，而擦除步骤无法触及这一点。我们引入了查询派生擦除方向（QED）。QED添加了一个源自查询且与键正交的第二个擦除方向。在快速权重视角中，键导向的delta编辑无法改变读取中与键正交的部分。它利用可编辑部分来消除沿查询方向测量的旧状态内容。它还在训练窗口之外的每个长度上改善了检索性能，并且在S-NIAH-1上将可用上下文长度大约翻倍。
tldr: 本论文提出了一种名为QED的新方法，通过添加与键正交的查询派生擦除方向，显著提高了线性注意力模型在长上下文中的检索能力，并将可用上下文长度翻倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces QED, a novel method that adds a query-derived erase direction orthogonal to the key, significantly improving retrieval in linear attention models at long contexts and doubling the usable context length.
